propositions: The transition command has two distinct force flags (--force for start-work gate, --force-close for completion gate) that should be unified into a single --force flag for consistency with the claim command.

The --force-close flag must be explicitly rejected with a CommandError naming --force, not silently skipped by the parser's unknown-token loop, to ensure stale callers fail loudly rather than bypassing gates silently.

After the rename, --force on open→in_progress bypasses the start-work gate (unchanged behavior), and --force on any close bypasses the completion gate with an optional reason value defaulting to '(no reason given)'.
The literal string --force-close must be removed from all tracked files except CHANGELOG.md, release-notes.md, frozen experiment corpora, the parser's rejection branch, and its regression test.

A concurrent commit (0767c38ebb) added scripts/dependency_audit.py emitting --force-close after this ticket's plan review, exposing the need for call-site parser validation tests that feed generated argv to the real _parse_flags.
